fusions.name: Bindweed Bars
fusions.desc: Closes a cage of thorned vine on one enemy, dealing 12 damage and stunning it for 1.2 seconds. The thorns leave it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Flytrap Clasp
fusions.desc: Snaps shut on one enemy for 16 damage and uses up every affliction you have on it, dealing 60% more damage for each one. The target is [Pinned] for 2 seconds and 10% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Hedgerow
fusions.desc: Raises a hedge 6.5 tiles long ahead of you that nothing crosses for 6 seconds. Enemies it strikes move 20% slower for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Wicker Ribs
fusions.desc: When you are hurt by anything but fire, woven branches close around you as a shield worth 15% of your maximum health for 5 seconds. Once every 20 seconds.
